lines.1: The drama club gathered in the club room again.
lines.2: 「Today we're training for the inter-club relay.」
lines.3: Oh yeah. There was an event like that too, wasn't there?
lines.4: 「We can't exactly go in without practicing at all.」
lines.5: 「Just make sure everyone knows how it'll work.」
lines.6: 「Meanwhile, Tsushima will practice customer service with me.」
lines.8: 「The inter-club relay is basically a comedy event.」
lines.9: 「I'll be stationed at the school gate during it.」
lines.10: 「Seems like the club president should be the one joining in that kind of fun...」
lines.13: Close one. Konoe had almost lunged at me full force.
lines.15: After changing, we moved to the school gate.
lines.16: 「There's something kind of stiff about your acting.」
lines.17: 「You're only a helper, but I'm still going to make sure you do this properly.」
lines.18: 「Yeah. If I'm doing it, I might as well do it perfectly.」
lines.20: 「Hey, why are you picking a fight with me!?」
lines.22: 「Something about looking at you just makes me want to pick at you.」
lines.26: If I didn't do this right, the stress alone would kill me...
lines.28: 「Everyone is welcome at our school! Please enjoy your stay!」
lines.31: 「Improvising is fine. It's how you're doing it that's bad.」
lines.32: 「And when you project your voice, you need to do it more like...」
lines.35: 「Here is your pamphlet for the Sports and Martial Arts Festival. Please take your time and enjoy yourselves.」
lines.36: 「...Yeah. You're starting to look the part.」
lines.38: 「But there's still something stiff about you.」
lines.40: 「When you play a role, becoming that person is important.」
lines.41: 「I see... Don't just act like him. Perform as if I actually am him.」
lines.42: 「Use your own imagination and become the butler.」
lines.43: 「So I should use my imagination to fill in what kind of man this butler is, what sort of life he's lived, all of that--then become him.」
lines.44: 「That's taking it pretty far, but you're not wrong.」
lines.45: 「All right... Time to build myself a character.」
lines.46: 「First, I get sold off to pay a debt... then somebody buys me at an auction.」
lines.48: 「Then the twintailed head maid at the mansion keeps riding the new guy--me--over every little thing.」
lines.49: 「Huh. Sounds like an awful head maid.」
lines.50: 「Yeah. She's always got it in for me, showering me with abuse--calling me spineless, stupid, every insult she can think of...」
lines.52: She came at me like a charging bull.
lines.56: 「That's not what I mean! 'Whoa there' is mainly what you say to a horse, so when I said 'am I an animal,' I was making an analogy--」
lines.57: She'd responded to my provocation with a completely serious explanation.
lines.58: 「Sorry. We're getting sidetracked. I'll take this seriously.」
lines.59: I buckled down and practiced for real.
lines.63: 「Next is practical training. Try actually serving a third party as a butler.」
lines.65: 「That wouldn't be much training. An outsider would be better. We'll ask the next person who comes through this gate. It won't take long.」
lines.66: 「If they look scary, can we skip them?」
lines.67: 「Nope. What would be the point of training? Whoever comes through, we're asking them.」
lines.69: Please let it be somebody easy to deal with.
lines.70: 「Man. Helping out even on a day off? What a drag.」
lines.72: 「I'm so beautiful today, a girl could get pregnant just looking at me.」
lines.73: 「Erika, please don't say things like that.」
lines.75: I hadn't expected all of them to show up on a day off just to help everyone.
lines.76: 「Konoe, please don't make me practice on those people.」
lines.77: 「You won't get to say that when you're actually serving visitors.」
lines.79: 「Excuse me, could I have a moment?」
lines.80: 「Whoa! A maid outfit!! Japan's national costume!!」
lines.82: 「...Have my fantasies finally manifested, and the characters started taking physical form!?」
lines.83: 「Oh, Leo. What's with the fancy getup?」
lines.85: 「Dressed as a butler? Do you want to serve me that badly, Tsushima-kun?」
lines.86: 「Nao-chan, that outfit looks good on you.」
lines.87: 「Thanks. Sato-san, I have a favor to ask.」
lines.89: 「Sure. I play the customer and check whether your acting works, right? Sounds good.」
lines.90: 「All right, Leo! I'll give your groveling servant act a nice, thorough inspection. Consider yourself honored.」
